blocks.text: When I began speaking with university students almost three years ago, most of them could not tell me what WPS stood for. This was true in nearly every part of the country I visited. Today, Filipinos of every age and social standing say it without hesitation: West Philippine Sea. That change was not an accident. When the Philippine Coast Guard began publicizing Chinese harassment in early 2023, the objective was defined from the start, and it has not changed: to make our own countrymen aware.
